Part One: The Title (2) Part One: The Direct Explanation of the Title (2) Part One: Narrating the Various Masters’ Single Interpretation of the Name Based on the Questioner The title of this work is *Vimalakīrtinirdeśa-sūtra*. Regarding its name, there are various interpretations among the masters. Some explain it by focusing solely on the questioner, Vimalakīrti. They argue that because he is free from all defilements (*vimala*) and his fame (*kīrti*) is renowned throughout the world, he is called "Vimalakīrti. Furthermore, since he expounds the profound Dharma while manifesting as a layman, he is designated by this name. This interpretation emphasizes the primary role of the interlocutor in eliciting the discourse. Thus, the title is derived from the specific identity and function of the one who poses the questions. This concludes the section on the single interpretation based on the questioner.
